Tutorial 2 — batch projects from CSV profiles#

Build five GQ/H projects from CSV layer definitions, batch-compute them against motions from the RSSeismic motion folder, then read deepsoilout.db3 files and aggregate response plots with Matplotlib.

Requires: RSSeismic scripting server; NumPy and Matplotlib in your Python environment.

Input CSVs live under examples/Tutorial_2/Inputs/ (one file per case). Column layout:

layer,thickness_m,unit_weight,vs_m_s,shear_strength_kPa,soil_type,curve_model,reduction_factor_formulation,ref_params
1,5,20,200.0,35,Sand,Darendeli_2001,MRDF_UIUC,Ko=0.46;PI=0
2,5,20,225.0,105.1,Sand,Darendeli_2001,MRDF_UIUC,Ko=0.46;PI=0

Download inputs (place under examples/Tutorial_2/Inputs/ next to the script):

  • profile_01.csv

  • profile_02.csv

  • profile_03.csv

  • profile_04.csv

  • profile_05.csv

Run from the repository root:

python examples/Tutorial_2/Scripting-Tutorial_2.py

  1"""
  2Workflow
  3--------
  4  Step 0  Import libraries
  5  Step 1  Configuration (5 CSV → project paths, motion folder, batch settings)
  6  Step 2  Connect to RSSeismic
  7  Step 3  Resolve motion names (all motions under MOTION_DIR)
  8  Step 4  Build 5 project files from CSV (single Profile 1, MRDF fit, save)
  9  Step 5  Batch compute all projects with the same motion selection
 10  Step 6  Read deepsoilout.db3 from disk (no scripting API — RSSeismic can be closed)
 11  Step 7  Aggregate and write PNG plots
 12
 13Steps 1–5 require the RSSeismic scripting server. Steps 6–7 are pure Python and can
 14even be run later on another machine that only has the project/result folders.
 15
 16CSV columns: thickness_m, unit_weight, vs_m_s, shear_strength_kPa, soil_type,
 17curve_model, reduction_factor_formulation, ref_params (optional)
 18Sample CSVs : profile_01.csv … profile_05.csv in Inputs/ (see Step 1)
 19
 20Run from the repo root:
 21
 22    python examples/Tutorial_2/Scripting-Tutorial_2.py
 23"""

 75def connect_app() -> RSSeismicApplication:
 76    app = RSSeismicApplication(port=SCRIPTING_PORT)
 77    app.ping()
 78    return app

 82# STEP 3 — Resolve motion names
 83# =============================================================================
 84
 85def _motion_file_in_directory(file_path: str, motion_dir: str) -> bool:
 86    file_abs = os.path.normcase(os.path.abspath(file_path))
 87    dir_abs = os.path.normcase(os.path.abspath(motion_dir))
 88    return file_abs == dir_abs or file_abs.startswith(dir_abs + os.sep)
 89
 90
 91def resolve_motion_names(model) -> list[str]:
 92    motion_dir = os.path.normpath(MOTION_DIR)
 93    model.Motions.addMotionDirectory(motion_dir)
 94    model.Motions.refreshMotionsList()
 95
 96    all_motions = model.Motions.listMotions()
 97    if MOTION_NAMES:
 98        model.Motions.setMotionSelection(MOTION_NAMES, selectOnlyListed=True)
 99        return list(MOTION_NAMES)
100
101    target_names = [
102        motion.name for motion in all_motions
103        if _motion_file_in_directory(motion.filePath, motion_dir)
104    ]
105    model.Motions.setMotionSelection(target_names, selectOnlyListed=True)
106    return target_names

109# =============================================================================
110# STEP 4 — Build project files from CSV
111# =============================================================================
112
113@dataclass
114class ProfileLayerRow:
115    thickness_m: float
116    unit_weight: float
117    vs_m_s: float
118    shear_strength_kPa: float
119    soil_type: str
120    curve_model: str
121    reduction_factor_formulation: str
122    ref_params: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
123
124
125def _cell(row: dict[str, str], key: str) -> str:
126    return row.get(key, "").strip()
127
128
129def _require_float(row: dict[str, str], key: str) -> float:
130    return float(_cell(row, key))
131
132
133def parse_key_value_params(text: str) -> dict[str, str]:
134    if not text.strip():
135        return {}
136    params: dict[str, str] = {}
137    for part in text.split(";"):
138        part = part.strip()
139        if not part:
140            continue
141        key, _, value = part.partition("=")
142        key, value = key.strip(), value.strip()
143        if key and value:
144            params[key] = value
145    return params
146
147
148def apply_scalar_params(accessor, params: dict[str, str]) -> None:
149    for key, value in params.items():
150        accessor.setDoubleProperty(key, float(value))
151
152
153def load_profile_rows(csv_path: str) -> list[ProfileLayerRow]:
154    csv_path = os.path.normpath(csv_path)
155    with open(csv_path, newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig") as handle:
156        data_lines = [
157            line for line in handle
158            if line.strip() and not line.lstrip().startswith("#")
159        ]
160        reader = csv.DictReader(data_lines)
161
162        rows: list[ProfileLayerRow] = []
163        for raw in reader:
164            if not any(_cell(raw, key) for key in raw):
165                continue
166
167            rows.append(ProfileLayerRow(
168                thickness_m=_require_float(raw, "thickness_m"),
169                unit_weight=_require_float(raw, "unit_weight"),
170                vs_m_s=_require_float(raw, "vs_m_s"),
171                shear_strength_kPa=_require_float(raw, "shear_strength_kPa"),
172                soil_type=_cell(raw, "soil_type"),
173                curve_model=_cell(raw, "curve_model"),
174                reduction_factor_formulation=_cell(raw, "reduction_factor_formulation"),
175                ref_params=parse_key_value_params(_cell(raw, "ref_params")),
176            ))
177
178    return rows
179
180
181def mrdf_fitting_procedure(formulation: str) -> str | None:
182    if formulation == "None":
183        return None
184    if formulation == "MRDF_Darendeli":
185        return "MRDF_Derendeli"
186    return "MRDF_UIUC"
187
188
189def configure_project_settings(model) -> None:
190    model.ProjectSettings.changeUnitSystem(UnitSystem.Metric)
191    model.ProjectSettings.Data.setBoolValue("automaticProfileGeneration", False)
192    model.ProjectSettings.Data.setEnumValue("analysisMode", "Nonlinear")
193    model.ProjectSettings.Data.setEnumValue("defaultSoilModel", "GQ_H")
194    model.ProjectSettings.Data.setEnumValue("hystereticFormulation", "NonMasing")
195
196
197def build_profile_from_csv(model, csv_path: str, profile_name: str = PROFILE_NAME) -> None:
198    rows = load_profile_rows(csv_path)
199    model.Profiles.setActiveProfile(profile_name)
200
201    existing = model.Profiles.listActiveSoilLayers()
202    need = len(rows) - len(existing)
203    if need > 0:
204        model.SoilLayers.appendLayers(need)
205
206    for summary, spec in zip(model.Profiles.listActiveSoilLayers(), rows):
207        layer = model.Profiles.getSoilLayer(summary.layerID)
208
209        layer.setSoilModel("GQ_H")
210        layer.setThickness(spec.thickness_m)
211        layer.setUnitWeight(spec.unit_weight)
212        layer.Data.setDoubleProperty("ShearWaveVelocity", spec.vs_m_s)
213        layer.Data.setDoubleProperty("ShearStrength", spec.shear_strength_kPa)
214
215        ref = layer.ReferenceCurve
216        ref.setSoilType(spec.soil_type)
217        ref.setCurveModel(spec.curve_model)
218        apply_scalar_params(ref.Data, spec.ref_params)
219
220        ref.generateReferenceCurve()
221        fit_proc = mrdf_fitting_procedure(spec.reduction_factor_formulation)
222        if fit_proc is not None:
223            layer.Curve.runCurveFit(fit_proc)
224
225
226def build_all_projects(app: RSSeismicApplication, motion_names: list[str]) -> list[str]:
227    os.makedirs(OUTPUT_PROJECT_DIR, exist_ok=True)
228    project_paths: list[str] = []
229
230    for _, csv_path, project_path in PROJECT_CASES:
231        model = app.newProject()
232        configure_project_settings(model)
233        build_profile_from_csv(model, csv_path)
234        resolve_motion_names(model)
235        model.Motions.setMotionSelection(motion_names, selectOnlyListed=True)
236        model.saveAs(project_path)
237        model.close(saveProject=False)
238        project_paths.append(os.path.normpath(project_path))
239
240    return project_paths
241

243# =============================================================================
244# STEP 5 — Batch compute
245# =============================================================================
246
247def run_batch_compute(app: RSSeismicApplication, project_paths: list[str], motion_names: list[str]):
248    batch_result = app.runBatchCompute(
249        project_paths,
250        motion_names=motion_names,
251        parallel_degree=PARALLEL_DEGREE,
252        max_concurrent_analyses=MAX_CONCURRENT_ANALYSES,
253        timeout=COMPUTE_TIMEOUT,
254        close_save_project=False,
255        continue_on_error=CONTINUE_ON_ERROR,
256    )
257
258    ok = sum(1 for job in batch_result.results if job.success and not job.partial_success)
259    partial = sum(1 for job in batch_result.results if job.success and job.partial_success)
260    failed = sum(1 for job in batch_result.results if not job.success)
261    print()
262    print("=" * 70)
263    print(f"  Batch complete — {len(batch_result.results)} project(s)")
264    print(f"  Full success : {ok}   Partial : {partial}   Failed : {failed}")
265    print("=" * 70)
266    for job in batch_result.results:
267        name = os.path.basename(job.file_path)
268        status = "OK" if job.success and not job.partial_success else (
269            "PARTIAL" if job.success else "FAILED"
270        )
271        print(f"  [{status:7s}]  {name}")
272        if job.error_message:
273            print(f"             {job.error_message}")
274    print()
275
276    return batch_result
277

279# =============================================================================
280# STEP 6 — Read results from disk
281# =============================================================================
282
283DB3_FILENAME = "deepsoilout.db3"
284MOTION_FOLDER_PREFIX = "Motion_"
285RS_LAYER_INDEX = 1
286
287
288def compute_results_root(project_path: str) -> str:
289    project_path = os.path.normpath(project_path)
290    project_dir = os.path.dirname(project_path)
291    stem = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(project_path))[0]
292    return os.path.join(project_dir, stem)
293
294
295def iter_deepsoilout_db3(results_root: str):
296    if not os.path.isdir(results_root):
297        return
298
299    for profile_folder in sorted(os.listdir(results_root)):
300        profile_dir = os.path.join(results_root, profile_folder)
301        if not os.path.isdir(profile_dir):
302            continue
303        for motion_folder in sorted(os.listdir(profile_dir)):
304            if not motion_folder.startswith(MOTION_FOLDER_PREFIX):
305                continue
306            db3_path = os.path.join(profile_dir, motion_folder, DB3_FILENAME)
307            if os.path.isfile(db3_path):
308                motion_label = motion_folder[len(MOTION_FOLDER_PREFIX):]
309                yield profile_folder, motion_label, db3_path
310
311
312def read_standard_db3(db3_path: str, rs_layer_index: int = RS_LAYER_INDEX) -> tuple[
313    np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray,
314]:
315    rs_column = f"LAYER{rs_layer_index}_RS"
316    with sqlite3.connect(db3_path) as conn:
317        rs_rows = conn.execute(
318            f"SELECT PERIOD, {rs_column} FROM RESPONSE_SPECTRA"
319        ).fetchall()
320        profile_rows = conn.execute(
321            "SELECT DEPTH_LAYER_MID, MAX_STRAIN, PGA_TOTAL FROM PROFILES"
322        ).fetchall()
323
324    periods = np.array([row[0] for row in rs_rows], dtype=float)
325    rs_values = np.array([row[1] for row in rs_rows], dtype=float)
326    depths = np.array([row[0] for row in profile_rows], dtype=float)
327    strains = np.array([row[1] for row in profile_rows], dtype=float)
328    pga_values = np.array([row[2] for row in profile_rows], dtype=float)
329    return periods, rs_values, depths, strains, pga_values
330
331
332@dataclass
333class AggregatedSamples:
334    rs_periods: list[np.ndarray] = field(default_factory=list)
335    rs_values: list[np.ndarray] = field(default_factory=list)
336    strain_depths: list[np.ndarray] = field(default_factory=list)
337    strain_values: list[np.ndarray] = field(default_factory=list)
338    pga_depths: list[np.ndarray] = field(default_factory=list)
339    pga_values: list[np.ndarray] = field(default_factory=list)
340    rs_units: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
341    depth_units: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
342    pga_units: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
343
344
345def collect_results_from_disk(project_paths: list[str]) -> AggregatedSamples:
346    samples = AggregatedSamples()
347    samples.rs_units = {"period": "s", "rs": "g"}
348    samples.depth_units = {"depth": "m"}
349    samples.pga_units = {"pga": "g"}
350
351    allowed_motions: set[str] | None = None
352    if MOTION_NAMES:
353        allowed_motions = set(MOTION_NAMES)
354
355    for project_path in project_paths:
356        results_root = compute_results_root(project_path)
357        for profile_folder, motion_label, db3_path in iter_deepsoilout_db3(results_root):
358            if allowed_motions and motion_label not in allowed_motions:
359                continue
360
361            periods, rs_values, depths, strains, pga_values = read_standard_db3(db3_path)
362            samples.rs_periods.append(periods)
363            samples.rs_values.append(rs_values)
364            samples.strain_depths.append(depths)
365            samples.strain_values.append(strains)
366            samples.pga_depths.append(depths)
367            samples.pga_values.append(pga_values)
368
369    return samples
370

372# =============================================================================
373# STEP 7 — Aggregate and plot
374# =============================================================================
375
376matplotlib.rcParams.update({
377    "font.family": "Times New Roman",
378    "font.size": 12,
379    "axes.labelsize": 12,
380    "legend.fontsize": 12,
381    "xtick.labelsize": 12,
382    "ytick.labelsize": 12,
383})
384_INDIVIDUAL = dict(color="silver", linewidth=0.7, alpha=0.65, marker="o", markersize=3)
385_MEAN = dict(color="black", linewidth=1.5, marker="o", markersize=4)
386_BOUND = dict(color="black", linewidth=1.0, linestyle="--", marker="o", markersize=3)
387
388
389def strain_to_percent(strain: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
390    return strain.astype(float) * 100.0
391
392
393def log_mean_std(
394    x_arrays: list[np.ndarray],
395    y_arrays: list[np.ndarray],
396    common_x: np.ndarray,
397    *,
398    log_x: bool = False,
399    log_y: bool = True,
400) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
401    n_pts = len(common_x)
402    n_samp = len(x_arrays)
403    matrix = np.full((n_pts, n_samp), np.nan)
404
405    cx = np.log(common_x) if log_x else common_x
406    for j, (x, y) in enumerate(zip(x_arrays, y_arrays)):
407        order = np.argsort(x)
408        xs, ys = x[order], y[order]
409        xj = np.log(np.clip(xs, 1e-300, None)) if log_x else xs
410        matrix[:, j] = np.interp(cx, xj, ys)
411
412    valid = np.isfinite(matrix) & (matrix > 0)
413    if log_y:
414        with np.errstate(divide="ignore", invalid="ignore"):
415            ln_mat = np.where(valid, np.log(matrix), np.nan)
416            mu = np.nanmean(ln_mat, axis=1)
417            sigma = np.nanstd(ln_mat, axis=1, ddof=1)
418        return np.exp(mu), np.exp(mu + sigma), np.exp(mu - sigma)
419
420    mu = np.nanmean(matrix, axis=1)
421    sigma = np.nanstd(matrix, axis=1, ddof=1)
422    return mu, mu + sigma, mu - sigma
423
424
425def aggregate_by_layer_index(
426    depth_arrays: list[np.ndarray],
427    value_arrays: list[np.ndarray],
428    *,
429    log_y: bool = True,
430) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
431    max_layers = max(len(d) for d in depth_arrays)
432    mean_depths: list[float] = []
433    val_means: list[float] = []
434    val_uppers: list[float] = []
435    val_lowers: list[float] = []
436
437    for layer_idx in range(max_layers):
438        depths: list[float] = []
439        values: list[float] = []
440        for depth_arr, value_arr in zip(depth_arrays, value_arrays):
441            if layer_idx < len(depth_arr):
442                depths.append(float(depth_arr[layer_idx]))
443                values.append(float(value_arr[layer_idx]))
444        if not values:
445            continue
446
447        values_arr = np.array(values, dtype=float)
448        if log_y:
449            positive = values_arr[values_arr > 0]
450            if positive.size == 0:
451                continue
452            ln_vals = np.log(positive)
453            mu = float(np.mean(ln_vals))
454            sigma = float(np.std(ln_vals, ddof=1)) if positive.size > 1 else 0.0
455            val_means.append(math.exp(mu))
456            val_uppers.append(math.exp(mu + sigma))
457            val_lowers.append(math.exp(mu - sigma))
458        else:
459            mu = float(np.mean(values_arr))
460            sigma = float(np.std(values_arr, ddof=1)) if values_arr.size > 1 else 0.0
461            val_means.append(mu)
462            val_uppers.append(mu + sigma)
463            val_lowers.append(mu - sigma)
464        mean_depths.append(float(np.mean(depths)))
465
466    return (
467        np.array(mean_depths),
468        np.array(val_means),
469        np.array(val_uppers),
470        np.array(val_lowers),
471    )
472
473
474def _sorted_layer_profile(values: np.ndarray, depths: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
475    order = np.argsort(depths)
476    return values[order], depths[order]
477
478
479def plot_aggregated(samples: AggregatedSamples, output_dir: str) -> None:
480    n = len(samples.rs_periods)
481    print(f"Total samples (project × motion pairs): {n}")
482
483    period_unit = samples.rs_units.get("period", "s")
484    rs_unit = samples.rs_units.get("rs", "g")
485    depth_unit = samples.depth_units.get("depth", "m")
486    pga_unit = samples.pga_units.get("pga", "g")
487
488    period_grid = np.sort(samples.rs_periods[0][samples.rs_periods[0] > 0])
489    rs_mean, rs_upper, rs_lower = log_mean_std(
490        samples.rs_periods, samples.rs_values, period_grid, log_x=True, log_y=True,
491    )
492
493    fig1, ax1 = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 4.5))
494    for xp, yp in zip(samples.rs_periods, samples.rs_values):
495        ax1.semilogx(xp, yp, **_INDIVIDUAL)
496    ax1.semilogx(period_grid, rs_mean, label=r"$\mu_{\ln}$", **_MEAN)
497    ax1.semilogx(period_grid, rs_upper, label=r"$\mu_{\ln} \pm \sigma_{\ln}$", **_BOUND)
498    ax1.semilogx(period_grid, rs_lower, **_BOUND)
499    ax1.set_xscale("log")
500    ax1.set_yscale("linear")
501    ax1.set_xlabel(f"Period ({period_unit})")
502    ax1.set_ylabel(f"Spectral Acceleration ({rs_unit})")
503    ax1.legend(frameon=False)
504    ax1.grid(True, which="both", alpha=0.3)
505    fig1.tight_layout()
506
507    strain_pct_samples = [strain_to_percent(v) for v in samples.strain_values]
508    s_depths, s_mean, s_upper, s_lower = aggregate_by_layer_index(
509        samples.strain_depths, strain_pct_samples, log_y=True,
510    )
511
512    fig2, ax2 = plt.subplots(figsize=(4, 5.5))
513    for strain_pct, depths in zip(strain_pct_samples, samples.strain_depths):
514        xs, ys = _sorted_layer_profile(strain_pct, depths)
515        ax2.plot(xs, ys, **_INDIVIDUAL)
516    ax2.plot(s_mean, s_depths, label=r"$\mu_{\ln}$", **_MEAN)
517    ax2.plot(s_upper, s_depths, label=r"$\mu_{\ln} \pm \sigma_{\ln}$", **_BOUND)
518    ax2.plot(s_lower, s_depths, **_BOUND)
519    ax2.set_xlabel("Max Shear Strain (%)")
520    ax2.set_ylabel(f"Depth ({depth_unit})")
521    ax2.invert_yaxis()
522    ax2.legend(frameon=False)
523    ax2.grid(True, which="major", alpha=0.3)
524    fig2.tight_layout()
525
526    p_depths, p_mean, p_upper, p_lower = aggregate_by_layer_index(
527        samples.pga_depths, samples.pga_values, log_y=True,
528    )
529
530    fig3, ax3 = plt.subplots(figsize=(4, 5.5))
531    for pga, depths in zip(samples.pga_values, samples.pga_depths):
532        xs, ys = _sorted_layer_profile(pga, depths)
533        ax3.plot(xs, ys, **_INDIVIDUAL)
534    ax3.plot(p_mean, p_depths, label=r"$\mu_{\ln}$", **_MEAN)
535    ax3.plot(p_upper, p_depths, label=r"$\mu_{\ln} \pm \sigma_{\ln}$", **_BOUND)
536    ax3.plot(p_lower, p_depths, **_BOUND)
537    ax3.set_xlabel(f"PGA ({pga_unit})")
538    ax3.set_ylabel(f"Depth ({depth_unit})")
539    ax3.invert_yaxis()
540    ax3.legend(frameon=False)
541    ax3.grid(True, which="major", alpha=0.3)
542    fig3.tight_layout()
543
544    os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)
545    for fig, name in [
546        (fig1, "response_spectra.png"),
547        (fig2, "max_strain_profile.png"),
548        (fig3, "pga_profile.png"),
549    ]:
550        path = os.path.join(output_dir, name)
551        fig.savefig(path, dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight")
552        print(f"Saved: {path}")
553        plt.close(fig)
554
555
556# =============================================================================
557# Main — run Steps 2–7
558# =============================================================================
559
560def main() -> None:
561    app = connect_app()
562
563    # Step 3 — Resolve motion names once
564    probe = app.newProject()
565    motion_names = resolve_motion_names(probe)
566    probe.close(saveProject=False)
567
568    # Step 4 — Build and save all projects
569    project_paths = build_all_projects(app, motion_names)
570
571    # Step 5 — Batch compute
572    run_batch_compute(app, project_paths, motion_names)
573    app.close()
574
575    # Step 6 — Read results from disk
576    samples = collect_results_from_disk(project_paths)
577
578    # Step 7 — Aggregate and plot
579    plot_aggregated(samples, OUTPUT_PLOT_DIR)
580
581
582if __name__ == "__main__":
583    main()
